title: trichocentrum johnii
intro: Trichocentrum johnii, commonly known as the Yellow Butterfly Orchid, is a species of flowering orchid native to Central and South America. This plant is known for its bright yellow flowers and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Trichocentrum johnii include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, swelling, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor properties.
